// Spatial turbulence: fractal Brownian motion summing absolute values of each
// octave. Non-negative, with a billowy, cloud-like character and creases at
// the basis zero crossings.
type TurbulenceNoise3D
    implements IValue, IScalarField3D
{
    Basis: NoiseBasis;
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
    Octaves: Integer;
    Lacunarity: Number;
    Gain: Number;
}
